import json, random
rng = random.Random(99)
# Case A: big random graph, 16 fairness actions (8 weak, 8 strong)
N = 12000
names = ["a%d" % i for i in range(16)]
states = [{"delivered":[[]], "slots":[]} for _ in range(N)]
edges = []
used = set()
for i in range(60000):
    s = rng.randrange(N); t = rng.randrange(N); nm = names[rng.randrange(16)]
    if (s,nm,t) in used: continue
    used.add((s,nm,t)); edges.append([s,nm,t])
req = {"op":"audit","inputs":[[[5]]],"states":states,"edges":edges,"start":0,
       "fairness":[{"action":n,"mode":("weak" if i%2 else "strong")} for i,n in enumerate(names)]}
open("bigA.jsonl","w").write(json.dumps(req)+"\n")

# Case B: adversarial: 16 special states with self loops (one action each), big neutral part
N2 = 12000
names2 = ["z%d" % i for i in range(16)]
states2 = [{"delivered":[[]], "slots":[]} for _ in range(N2)]
edges2 = []
for i in range(16):
    edges2.append([i, names2[i], i])   # self loop with action z_i
# connect the rest into a big SCC with neutral edges
for i in range(16, N2-1):
    edges2.append([i, "n", i+1])
    edges2.append([i+1, "n", i])
edges2.append([0, "n", 16])
edges2.append([16, "n", 0])
req2 = {"op":"audit","inputs":[[[5]]],"states":states2,"edges":edges2,"start":0,
        "fairness":[{"action":n,"mode":"strong"} for n in names2]}
open("bigB.jsonl","w").write(json.dumps(req2)+"\n")
print("ok")
PYEOF
echo "=== Case A ==="; time python3 -I /app/submission/main.py < bigA.jsonl | head -c 200; echo; echo "=== Case B ==="; time python3 -I /app/submission/main.py < bigB.jsonl | head -c 200
